names.note: Read out of doxologia.ro's line for 25 aprilie, «Sfântul Cuvios Vasile de la Poiana Mărului».
Read out of saint.gr's line for 25 Απριλίου, «Όσιος Βασίλειος ο Ησυχαστής», with the rank word and the epithet left off.

The two words the day’s line uses, «Прп. Василия Поляномерульского», with the rank stripped per BRIEF.md §4. The name page’s title adds a parenthetical «(Пояна-Мэрулуйский)», which is the same place-name rendered from the Romanian «Poiana Mărului» instead of calqued, and not a further part of the name; it is recorded here and was not stored. Measured against the gate’s own key function before it was written: 'василии поляномерульскии' has no other holder, where the bare «βασιλειοσ» fold holds thirty-three.

birth.note: doxologia.ro's life: «Acesta s-a născut din părinți dreptcredincioși, la anul 1692, în părțile Rusiei».

death.note: doxologia.ro's life: «a trecut cu pace la Domnul, la 25 aprilie, în anul mântuirii 1767».

source.text: Православный церковный календарь, Сретенский монастырь (days.pravoslavie.ru), 25 апреля ст. ст. — «Прп. Василия Поляномерульского (1767) (Рум.).»

attestations.note: The day’s third entry, and a LINE-ONLY UPGRADE. The line carries the calendar’s own «(Рум.)» mark for a Romanian commemoration and NO LINK TO A LIFE. The name page behind it, 14455, is titled «Василий Поляномерульский (Пояна-Мэрулуйский), прп.», heads «День памяти: 25 апреля» — one day only, with no second — and prints three icons and three links under «Статьи на Православие.Ru»: two pieces by Богдан Лупеску both called «Святой Василий Поляномерульский», and one «Преподобный Василий Поляномерульский». THOSE ARE MAGAZINE ARTICLES ON THE SAME SITE AND NOT THE CALENDAR’S OWN READING, so NONE OF THEM WAS READ and nothing out of their teaser sentences is in this folder; they are the one place more about him is to be had on that site and they are named here. The year the line prints, 1767, is the year the folder already holds off doxologia’s life, «a trecut cu pace la Domnul, la 25 aprilie, în anul mântuirii 1767», so `dates` was not touched. The day page prints six hymns and NONE under his name. azbyka.ru was not read.

source.text: Calendarul zilei, Doxologia (doxologia.ro), 25 aprilie — «Sfântul Cuvios Vasile de la Poiana Mărului»
saint.gr, το εορτολόγιο της 25ης Απριλίου — «Όσιος Βασίλειος ο Ησυχαστής»

attestations.note: The life page heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 25 Απριλίου εκάστου έτους», the same day as the listing and the same day the Romanian calendar keeps him, and it is plainly the same man: born 1692 in Romania, an ascetic on the Holy Mountain and in the country of Poiana Mărului, teacher of Paisius Velichkovsky, dead in peace in 1767. **The Greek disagrees with this folder's own life about where he was born** — it says «στη Ρουμανία», in Romania, where doxologia.ro's life says «în părțile Rusiei», in the parts of Russia — and the existing `dates`, which carry the same 1692, were left untouched. The whole body of the Greek page is three sentences, and the only thing in them the Romanian life did not already have is the Holy Mountain. It prints no hymn and names no relic.
Not checked: the Ohrid Prologue at pravoslavno.rs for the corresponding Julian day (20 September 2026).
